title: 内角低位折线
description: 孔版印刷让浅角折线路线与成人稳态动作形成清晰节奏。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: An original risograph illustration depicts a fictional fully clothed adult following a low zigzag route across two faces of a shallow bouldering corner. Broad purple handholds and positive turquoise footholds alternate in a compact pattern, keeping both shoes close to the continuous crash mat. The climber moves one hand a short distance while maintaining a calm moderate stance and natural hip alignment. Use a wide oblique composition showing the full adult, both wall planes, and empty padded landing. Layer lilac, cobalt, and pale peach inks with subtle grain and imperfect registration. Preserve plausible limbs and shoe contact. Include no captions, brands, jumps, extreme splits, or high exposure.
